source: FEC bulk data, committee-to-committee transactions (itoth), cycles 2012-2018, downloaded Oct 25, 2026 from fec.gov/files/bulk-downloads. A gift is kept from the giving committee's report (24K/24Z) for candidate committees, or the receiving committee's report (18K/18Z) for the leadership PAC and joint fundraising committees; duplicates on giver, recipient, date and amount are dropped. Memo entries left out. Window: Jolly 2011-01-01 to 2017-01-03, Graham 2013-01-01 to 2017-01-03. cmteKind JFC-multi = a joint fundraising committee shared with other members (its receipts are not all for this member). Individuals are in indiv-receipts.json.
